cohort: The study included 18 newborns with a gestational age of >=32 weeks and/or birth weight of >=1.5 kg who required heart rate evaluation at birth.
finding: NeoBeat dry-electrode ECG demonstrated reliable and accurate heart rate measurement at birth, comparable to conventional ECG, and obtained a reliable signal significantly faster than pulse oximetry.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken simultaneously at birth for 10 minutes.
